data.name: Description
data.value: Link an external identity provider account to your local user so you can sign in through that provider, or remove an existing link.

data.name: NoProviderConfigured
data.value: No external identity provider is configured for this instance.

data.name: NoLinkedAccount
data.value: No external account is currently linked to your user.

data.name: UnlinkConfirmationBody
data.value: Removing this link will stop you from signing in via the external provider. For security reasons you will be signed out and need to sign back in. Continue?

data.name: UnlinkFailedLastCredential
data.value: This is your only sign-in method. Set a password or add a passkey before removing the link.

data.name: UnlinkFailed
data.value: The external account link could not be removed.
